mapper.select: select from t_job_position where deleted = 0 and enabled = 1 order by item_order, id
mapper.insert: insert into t_job_position(code, name, item_order, enabled, deleted) values(#{code}, #{name}, #{itemOrder}, #{enabled}, #{deleted})
insert into t_job_position(code, name, item_order, enabled, deleted) values(#{code}, #{name}, coalesce(#{itemOrder}, 0), coalesce(#{enabled}, 1), coalesce(#{deleted}, 0))
